privileged_info_for_vlm: The image is a real HST WFPC2 observation of globular cluster NGC 6652. The plate scale is 0.1 arcsec/pixel. The target is a close pair of stars (separation ~1.5-4.0 arcsec). Magnitude difference is calculated from the flux ratio (-2.5 * log10(F1/F2)). The agent must use AstroImageJ to extract these values.
